gloss: frost damage; damage caused by frost

definitions.gloss: frost damage; damage caused by frost
definitions.explanation: Damage to crops, plants, or agriculture caused by frost or freezing temperatures. A significant concern for farmers, especially during late spring when unexpected frost can destroy new growth.

examples.japanese: {霜害|そうがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やられた→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: The crops were ruined by frost damage.

examples.japanese: {遅霜|おそじも}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{霜害|そうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Caution is needed against frost damage from late frost.

examples.japanese: {茶畑|ちゃばたけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霜害|そうがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送風|そうふう}→送風：23691_soufuu⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Wind fans are installed in tea fields to prevent frost damage.

notes: Composed of {霜|そう} (frost) + ⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧ (damage, harm). Particularly affects ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea), ⟦{果樹|かじゅ}→果樹：27144_kaju⟧ (fruit trees), and ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (vegetables). Common collocations: {霜害|そうがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to suffer frost damage), {霜害|そうがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent frost damage), {霜害|そうがい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (frost damage countermeasures). Japanese tea farmers use {防霜|ぼうそう}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (frost prevention fans) installed above their fields. Part of the {〜害|がい} (damage from ~) word family, like ⟦{水害|すいがい}→水害：13261_suigai⟧ (flood damage) and {風害|ふうがい} (wind damage).
